steps.speaker: FAC Alert
steps.content: Contamination is spilling out of the Rust. Native Corruptors are spreading out and constantly threatening the isolation belt of the Rust.

steps.speaker: FAC Alert
steps.content: They have inherited many traits of the Sun Crow Apostle and are highly aggressive. To ensure the safety of both sides of the city, please spread out the defenses and rescue those who are in danger.

steps.speaker: Scavenger A
steps.content: What, monsters again?! Quick, call that Chief of the M-B-... something. He said to tell him immediately if anything happens... Ah!
steps.female_content: What, monsters again?! Quick, call that Chief of the M-B-... something. She said to tell her immediately if anything happens... Ah!

steps.content: A fissure suddenly opens up in front of him and contamination gushes out toward his waist. If not for a companion pulling him back in time, he would have been  trapped in contamination.

steps.speaker: Scavenger B
steps.content: This is way worse than the first time! Forget about the phone call, hide quickly!

Scavengers gather at the FAC's makeshift evacuation point on a raised area. Their sight is filled with surging contamination spilling from the carnival ruins, from which grotesque creatures are emerging.
Advancing against the waves of monsters are FAC warriors in white armor. They aim to repair the base near BR-001, but facing them is a constant flow of the Apostle's kin.

steps.speaker: Scavenger A
steps.content: What about those soldiers... What about that little girl...
